recon.notes: Both configured urls are Eventbrite organizer profile pages. Platform confirmed by a working endpoint: the SSR __NEXT_DATA__ payload (props.pageProps.upcomingEvents / hasMoreUpcoming / upcomingEventsTotal / organizer.metrics.totalEvents). window.__SERVER_DATA__ does not exist on these pages and /org/<id>/showmore/ returns 403, so neither was used. The scraper-input.js entry has '// discoveryOnly: true' commented out, i.e. discovery is NOT restricted to link-following; the entry sets no urlDiscoveryDepth, discovery patterns, alwaysBear, siteRole or automationEnabled. Twisted Bear is a touring brand (London-based, '20+ countries and 50 cities'), so city is set per event from the venue address rather than in defaults. Organizer B (Moo Productions Limited) is a UK company with 1 lifetime event and nothing upcoming.

coverage.basis: Organizer A __NEXT_DATA__: upcomingEvents.length 1, upcomingEventsTotal 1, hasMoreUpcoming false. Organizer B __NEXT_DATA__: upcomingEvents.length 0, upcomingEventsTotal 0, hasMoreUpcoming false, and the rendered DOM shows the positive empty state 'Nothing planned right now'. Second door for the one event: its event page JSON-LD (SocialEvent, EventScheduled, isSeries false, seriesId null, additionalSessionsCount 0 on the row) plus the rendered organizer card and the flyer all agree on 2026-09-26 21:00 at Icon DC. The only delta between doors is the end time: the organizer row says end_time 21:00:00 (equal to start) while the event page JSON-LD, the visible header '9 PM-3 AM', the description '9pm - 3am' and the flyer all say 03:00 the next morning; the event page is taken as truth. Past listings: neither organizer page ships past rows in the static payload; the Past tab exists and organizer.metrics.totalEvents implies 21 past events for A (22 lifetime - 1 upcoming) and 1 past for B (1 lifetime - 0 upcoming) - counted from the metric, not enumerated. Published now: 1 single event.

End time comes from the event page JSON-LD endDate 2026-09-27T03:00:00-04:00 and the visible '9 PM-3 AM' / '9pm - 3am' text; the organizer row's end_time 21:00:00 is a listing-only collapse and must not be taken as the end. series_id null, additionalSessionsCount 0, isSeries false: a single. The event description does not link twisted-bear.com anywhere on the Eventbrite page.

traps.label: 'Past' tab on the NAB Events, LLC organizer page (21 past events implied by total events 22)
traps.why: The organizer page has an Upcoming/Past tab pair. Past rows are not in the static __NEXT_DATA__ payload (pastEvents is absent) and load on demand from /org/<id>/showmore/, which answers 403 to a bare fetch. They are archives of previous Twisted Bear dates, not current events, and must not be enumerated here.

traps.label: 'Past' tab on the Moo Productions Limited organizer page (1 lifetime event, none upcoming)
traps.why: Organizer B lists nothing upcoming ('Nothing planned right now'); its single lifetime event is only reachable through the Past tab, which is not in the static payload. It is an archive, not a current listing.
